race.comment: COLUMBUS (1) still carries plenty of upside despite going under as an odds-on pop last start in Saturday grade. He had every chance there but still showed some inexperience. Blinkers go on now for the first time and McDonald sticks third-up. Better suited here and a forward showing is expected. DEEP PLEASURE (4) has just missed her past couple, including as favourite last start on the Kenso. Lloyd replaces the apprentice hoop and she gets the blinkers on first time today. Should get every chance to go one better. JOHN DORY (5) gets Berry in the irons today as he comes back a level, following a 1.7L defeat in a good performance at Rosehill 18 days ago. The inside draw should see him sit a touch closer in the run and he can be thereabouts once again. NAMASTE (6) was better last start at Canterbury and makes some appeal off the inside barrier. BELLE DETELLE (3) comes back in trip and onto a firmer deck today off a month-long break. Keeping her safe on the class drop.
